pairs.prompt: Describe a garden at dawn in two sentences.
pairs.A: The sky bleeds into shades of violet and gold as the first light filters through the dense canopy of trees. Dew-kissed petals glisten in the soft morning mist, while the air hums with the sudden awakening of birdsong.
pairs.B: The sky bleeds into soft pinks and purples as the first light filters through the dense canopy of trees. Dewdrops cling to the morning air, glistening like tiny diamonds on the dew-kissed petals of blooming flowers.
